capabilities: open a random broken link in the vault via a command
extras: README is minimal: one command, no settings, examples, or screenshots described.
motivation: The author wants to 'fill the holes in your knowledge' by turning broken links into serendipitous writing prompts.
problem: Obsidian shows unresolved links but offers no way to randomly surface them as prompts for which missing note to write next.
summary: Command-based plugin that opens a random broken (unresolved) link from your vault so you can fill in missing notes.
